description: IRIS evaluation protocol - DO NOT MODIFY after training starts

primary_metric.name: k-NN accuracy on held-out types
primary_metric.description: Pure zero-shot test. Extract embeddings for all samples. For each holdout sample, find k nearest neighbors among train+negatives. If majority of neighbors are drone types (not negative), count as correct detection. No fine-tuning, no linear head, no training of any kind.
primary_metric.success_threshold: k-NN(k=1) accuracy > 70% on holdout types (drone vs background)

secondary_metric.name: Linear probe accuracy
secondary_metric.description: Train a single Linear(768, n_classes) layer on frozen encoder outputs from 30 train types + negatives. Test on 7 holdout types + negatives. This tests if the representation is linearly separable even when k-NN doesn't show it.
secondary_metric.success_threshold: Linear probe accuracy > 80% on holdout (drone vs background binary)

baseline_comparison.name: Supervised CNN baseline
baseline_comparison.description: Train a CNN FROM SCRATCH with labels on the 30 train types + negatives. Same architecture as encoder. Test on 7 holdout types + negatives. This is the floor - if LeJEPA zero-shot beats this, something is wrong. If LeJEPA is within 10-15%, that's extremely strong.
baseline_comparison.expected: Supervised should beat zero-shot by 10-30% (it has labels)
baseline_comparison.headline_result: LeJEPA zero-shot within 15% of supervised baseline

tertiary_metrics.umap_visualization: 2D UMAP of all embeddings. Color: train=blue, holdout=RED, negatives=gray. Success = holdout clusters with train, NOT with negatives.
tertiary_metrics.centroid_distance: For each holdout type, distance to nearest train drone centroid vs distance to background centroid. Success = d_drone < d_background for at least 5/7 holdout types.
tertiary_metrics.silhouette_score: Silhouette score for holdout samples when assigned to drone cluster vs background. Success = positive silhouette.

integrity_rules: Split committed to split.json BEFORE training. Never modified.
No hyperparameter tuning based on holdout performance.
Report FIRST run results, not best of many.
If multiple runs are done, report ALL runs (not cherry-picked).

failure_protocol.if_knn_below_50pct: Model did not learn drone-ness. Try: more epochs, larger model, stronger augmentation, add projection head (already done).
failure_protocol.if_knn_50_70pct: Partial success. Model learned some drone-ness. Analyze WHICH holdout types fail - are they all one category? If yes, stratification issue. If random, augmentation issue.
failure_protocol.if_knn_70_85pct: Good result. Demo-worthy. Document and present.
failure_protocol.if_knn_above_85pct: Strong result. Consider: is this too good? Check for data leakage.
failure_protocol.if_collapse_detected: Stop immediately. Reduce lr 10x. Increase augmentation. Check data diversity. Resume from last good checkpoint.
